cases.name: task-capture-Nat
cases.source:
-- | Check task transfer independently of local handle copyability.
module Main where
  import Effect.Concurrent.MVar
  -- | Read the captured cell only after the task boundary.
  size :: MVar Nat ->{MVar, Diverge} Nat
  size cell = mvar-read cell
  -- | Both tasks retain access to the same runtime slot.
  work :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => MVar Nat ->{Async r, Cancel r, Diverge, MVar} Result LoadError (Nat, Nat)
  work cell = withScope $ \scope -> do
    first <- spawn scope (\() -> Ok (size cell))
    second <- spawn scope (\() -> Ok (size cell))
    joinAllOrCancel scope first second
  -- | This source-only probe does not start workers.
  main :: Int
  main = 0
